back: Trade in services: tourism, transport, insurance, banking, consultancy.
Balance of trade = visible exports − visible imports.
Invisible balance = invisible exports − invisible imports.
Current account = balance of trade + invisible balance (plus income and transfers in full accounts).
Follow the money: money flowing in = export; money flowing out = import. Foreign tourists at home = invisible export.

front: Causes of a current account deficit
back: High imports (fuel, machinery, food), low export prices or output, uncompetitive exports, strong currency, payments for services.
Import restrictions, export promotion, value addition, import substitution, devaluation, tourism promotion, reducing domestic spending.
Record of all transactions between a country and the rest of the world: current account and capital (financial) account.
